title: deep-mammography-positioning: An Interpretable, Measurement-Based AI Framework for Cross-View PNL Discrepancy in Mammographic Positioning QA
description: Code, training configurations and reference labels for the paper "An Interpretable, Measurement-Based AI Framework for Cross-View PNL Discrepancy in Mammographic Positioning QA": CRAUNet landmark detection (MLO pectoral line and nipple, CC nipple), the 10 mm posterior nipple line rule, dual-stream classifier baselines (ResNet-18, RadImageNet ResNet-50, ConvNeXt-Tiny), 10-fold cross-validation scripts, and reference landmarks for the internal (VinDr-Mammo) and external (Chinese Mammography Database, EMBED) cohorts. This release corresponds to the revised manuscript (R1).
